turns.assessment: The +4 dB indication is confined to trx.och188.a: the incoming S08 channel monitors and all amplifiers report no optical change, while pre-FEC BER, DGD, and SOP rate remain stable. A real upstream power excursion or gain change should have appeared in at least the relevant OCM, and documented RX_DEGRADATION should produce a receiver penalty/errors rather than an isolated favorable power shift. The evidence therefore points toward an unlisted receiver power-monitoring/calibration anomaly; the brief also inconsistently lists an est-OSNR change as O1 while saying that metric saw no change.

proposals.rationale: The localization is receiver-only, but the absence of any pre-FEC BER change or other receiver penalty argues strongly against the documented RX_DEGRADATION mode.

Handling can cause a no-alarm power excursion, but it should affect all channels and be visible to optical monitoring; the reported change also appears to be a sustained level step rather than a brief excursion.
